title: test(scenarios): give the built-consumer child-process cases a 120s timeout

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`built-consumer.test.ts` 里两个起子进程的用例(ESM/CJS)给了显式超时 120 秒,和同文件 `beforeAll` 一致。
- **为什么改**:合并队列满载时该文件跑了 9.4 秒,CJS 用例撞上 vitest 默认 5 秒超时变红,已把 #30954 踢出队列一次;队列里每个 PR 都会撞上。
- **风险与回滚**:只改一个测试文件的超时参数,断言一处没动,不是重试;回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:`packages/qa/scenarios/test/build/built-consumer.test.ts` 的 `it.each` 结尾。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/build`,预期 5/5。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/qa/scenarios/test/build/built-consumer.test.ts` (added by #30938): the `it.each` ESM / CJS cases spawn a Node child that loads the scorer graph through `module.registerHooks` resolve hooks. They ran on vitest's 5s default while only `beforeAll` had `120_000`. Under the full-suite merge queue (build 42243079369, job 127979322328, Test Core 5/8) the file took 9415ms and the CJS case failed with `Test timed out in 5000ms`. The cases now pass `120_000`, the budget `beforeAll` already uses. No assertion changed and nothing retries.

## Verification

At `9ab662dda1` (on `origin/main` `000a4c0d36`): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build` exit 0 (`check-dts-emitted` 10/10), `vitest run test/build` 5 passed (5), `typecheck` exit 0. `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 47 commands for this one file; they were still running when this PR opened. Results go to the seat, and CI runs the full set.

Test-only change in a private package: `skip-changeset`.
